name: Specialty Coffee Consumption
description: Size the market for specialty coffee consumption.
formula: TAM = Population x Penetration_rate x Purchase_frequency x Average_spend
solution_logic: Step 1: Identify addressable population = target_population x addressable_segment
Step 2: Apply penetration rate = addressable_population x penetration_rate
Step 3: Calculate annual spend per user = purchase_frequency x avg_spend_per_purchase
Step 4: Calculate TAM = penetrating_users x annual_spend_per_user
key_insight: The addressable segment here is regular coffee drinkers, not all adults -- conflating the two overstates the market by roughly 2-3x before a penetration rate is even applied.
common_mistakes: Sizing all adults instead of regular coffee drinkers specifically
Treating "bags per year" as annual dollar spend instead of multiplying it by price per bag
Using a penetration rate that assumes brand-level dominance instead of a realistic new-entrant share
framework_soundbite: Coffee drinkers, not adults; bags times price, not bags alone -- get those two right and the rest is arithmetic.
business_contexts: a specialty coffee roaster considering national retail expansion
a coffee subscription startup sizing its addressable market
question_patterns: A specialty coffee roaster is deciding whether to expand from regional cafes into national retail and wants to understand the size of the opportunity.

prompts.beginner: Estimate the total addressable market for specialty coffee sold direct-to-consumer.
prompts.intermediate: A specialty coffee roaster is deciding whether to expand from regional cafes into national retail and wants to understand the size of the opportunity.
prompts.advanced: A regional roaster known for its cafe experience is being courted by a national retailer for a private-label deal, but leadership is unsure whether the specialty segment is large enough to justify walking away from its retail footprint. Size the market before the board meeting.
